findings.issue: Each story has its own rationale, reused verbatim as the rationale of the LARINGE/FARINGE evidence entry. The APARELHO CARDIOVASCULAR evidence entry carries a stock sentence per term, with a missing full stop after the quoted description: “A fala contém os critérios da entrada Dispneia: sensação de diﬁculdade ou desconforto  para respirar O título do grupo não é atribuição etiológica.” and “A fala contém os critérios da entrada Tosse: expulsão súbita de ar O título do grupo não é atribuição etiológica.”. Rationales that mention another concept: 62 “sem inferir alteração vocal”, 65 “distinguindo-a de perda de força isolada”, 74 “não documenta despertar por dificuldade respiratória”, 76 and 79 “sem Expectoração”, 77 “sem inferir aspiração”. Index 65's rationale says “A paciente” and 71's “pelo paciente”; neither utterance states a gender. Indices 71, 76 and 77 say “Tosse seca”, which is a qualifier and not a script entry. Index 76 says the cough is “explicitamente descrita” where the utterance gives the onomatopoeia.
findings.resolution: No copy-paste leftover: every rationale refers to the symptom of its own story, by name or as breathing difficulty / lack of air (indices 65 and 68 do not use the word Dispneia), and none names the other group’s symptom (pattern checked by script for all twenty), and each mention of another concept is an exclusion that matches the utterance. Passing stories are not held for this. Suggested polish: add the full stop to the stock sentence and drop the gender words. For the held stories the rationale gaps are part of B021-01 and B021-02.

findings.issue: Indices 77 and 79 say “tossidas”, a lay noun with the root of the answer (Tosse). Index 66 says “dificuldade para respirar”, almost the printed description; index 78 says “expulso o ar de uma vez”, close to “expulsão súbita de ar”. Five of the ten Tosse stories (71, 73, 74, 76, 78) identify the cough with the same onomatopoeia “cof cof”. Indices 62, 65 and 74 contain disclaimers that answer questions nobody asked (“Não é que a voz tenha mudado”, “Não estou dizendo que meus braços perderam força”, “Não foi falta de ar me acordando”).
findings.resolution: None of these opens another term; all ten stories pass. Whether an utterance may contain the root of the answer (77, 79) is a product and teaching decision recorded as a question; the release builder does not test for it. Suggested polish for a later edit: vary the cough markers and turn the disclaimers into natural patient speech.
